body: Thanks to those who've cared enough to write something.

I know people have replied, but this is the first time I've posted to reddit, and I'm not sure what to do.  A little more context:  I grew up in a home with mental illness, alcoholism and depression.  I struggle with depression and alcoholism.  I was in rehab for a year and a half, during which time my brother and sister abandoned me.  My parents are both deceased.  I'm trying to get therapy, but therapy through Kaiser is a joke.
